{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin — a subagent_with_model tool plus a live multi-panel subagent viewer.","id":"gh:1334405383","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-subagent-max","slug":"aaravarr/dsh-subagent-max","topics":["dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins","panel","subagents"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin — a subagent_with_model tool plus a live multi-panel subagent viewer."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-subagent-max"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> Multi-panel live subagent viewer for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), plus a `subagent_with_model` tool for"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" per-call model/provider override."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"**Subagents tab** — a card grid grouped into active / inactive and sorted by last activity."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"**Floating viewer panel** — a draggable panel streaming a subagent's live output: task, reasoning, t"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ool calls, and text."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"A two-face DSH plugin:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **Host face** (`lib/index.js`) — a Cordis plugin that registers the `subagent_with_model` tool, a "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"thin wrapper over `ctx.subagents` that forwards `model` / `provider` into the child's `agentOptions`"},{"id":"p9s3","text":".
- **Client face** (`lib/client.js`) — a Web UI that renders every subagent as a draggable, resizab"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"le floating panel with live token-by-token output, plus a **Subagents** tab with a card grid."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- **Per-call model / provider override** — delegate to a subagent and pick its model explicitly.
- *"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"*Smart provider selection** — when no provider is given, prefer the parent's provider if it serves t"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"he requested model, otherwise auto-find a provider that carries it.
- **Multi-panel live viewer** — "},{"id":"p11s4","text":"open several subagent panels at once; each streams output in real time.
- **Rich block rendering** —"},{"id":"p11s5","text":" prompt block, reasoning (think) blocks, tool-call cards with input/output, streaming shimmer, markd"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"own.
- **Subagents tab** — card grid grouped into active / inactive and sorted by last activity; sho"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"ws model, tokens, steps, context % and relative update time.
- **Drag to pop out** — drag a card ont"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"o the canvas to open its panel exactly where you drop it (with a ghost preview).
- **Notifications**"},{"id":"p11s9","text":" — side-top toasts when a subagent starts or receives a message.
- **i18n** — zh / en, switchable fr"},{"id":"p11s10","text":"ts when a subagent starts or receives a message.
- **i18n** — zh / en, switchable from DSH settings."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"or, manually, place the package under `<profile>/node_modules/@aaravarr/dsh-subagent-max/` and add t"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"he entry to `cordis.patch.yml` (see Config)."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Config"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| Field | Type | Default | Description |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| `subagentProvider` | string | `spawn` | Subagent transport provider. |
| `toolName` | string | `su"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"bagent_with_model` | Model-facing tool name; must be unique among loaded tools. |
| `backgroundMode`"},{"id":"p18s3","text":" | string | `one-shot` | `continuable` returns a durable subagent id; `one-shot` runs foreground. |
"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"| `maxDepth` | number | `3` | Absolute delegation-depth cap for children (`0` forbids further delega"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"pth` | number | `3` | Absolute delegation-depth cap for children (`0` forbids further delegation). |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Ask the model to delegate with an explicit model:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"> Start a subagent with `deepseek-v4-flash` to review this repo's test coverage."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Tool parameters:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| Arg | Type | Required | Notes |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| `model` | string | yes | Child model id (e.g. `deepseek-v4-pro`, `deepseek-v4-flash`, `k3-256k`). "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"|
| `provider` | string | no | LLM provider route. Omitted -> auto-selected: the parent's own provid"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"er is preferred when it can serve the requested model; otherwise the first provider carrying that mo"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"del is used; if none does, the parent's provider is inherited (the child may then fail with `UNKNOWN"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"_MODEL`). |
| `description` | string | yes | Short (3-5 word) task label. |
| `prompt` | string | ye"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"s | Complete, self-contained task. |
| `run_in_background` | bool | no | Background routing; default"},{"id":"p24s7","text":" follows `backgroundMode`. |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Known Limitations"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- Model display is derived from the session's `request/header`; it can be absent for some children.
"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"- Last-activity time is tracked client-side and cached in `localStorage`; the first open after a fre"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"sh load may fall back to the session's `updatedAt`.
- Client UI targets the web platform only."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
